purpose: Record focused release command family preflight evidence before any physical package split.
policy: This evidence authorizes release family preflight only. It does not move release files, shared helpers, root wiring, JSON helpers, output helpers, adapters, or any other command family. A future split must move only the release family in one dedicated commit after this gate passes.

selectedFamily.reason: Release is ready for a single-family split because this preflight pins command registration, help routing, JSON envelope behavior, stdout/stderr discipline, release check evidence fields, and rollback gates while keeping all files in the current command package.
blockedMoves: do not move shared root command wiring
do not move JSON error helpers
do not move global output or IO helpers
do not move help or doctor adapters
do not move any non-release command family
selectedFamily.rollbackRequirement: Restore release files to cmd/gofly/internal/command and clear release from nextCandidates if release check JSON, help output, command registration, stdout, stderr, or required-check drift behavior changes.

localExecutionBoundary.policy: Local shell execution must remain separate from release output rendering during the future package split.

physicalSplitAdmission.allowedAction: Move only release family files into a dedicated release subpackage and preserve command registration, help routing, JSON contracts, stdout/stderr behavior, release evidence fields, and rollback notes.
requiredSignals: release preflight evidence is indexed by project-layout-governance
release preflight gate is part of docs-check
release family files still exist in cmd/gofly/internal/command during this preflight
release subpackage does not exist during this preflight
release check JSON blocker emits one release.check envelope with RELEASE_CHECK_FAILED
release and release check help topics remain routed through the help catalog
required-check drift gate remains a release split prerequisite

nextStep.action: Move only the release command family after the release preflight gate passes.
